description: Karnataka IT-BT and Science & Technology secretary N Manjula says the state government is planning to explore the use of treated wastewater for industrial purposes, including data centres
body_lead: Karnataka is stepping up its technology push with focus on artificial intelligence (AI), startup funding, sustainable data centres and decentralising the technology ecosystem beyond Bengaluru. In an interview to Moneycontrol, Karnataka IT-BT and science & technology secretary Dr N Manjula outlined plans to launch Nipuna Edge AI skilling programme, Rs 200-crore fund of funds, promote treated wastewater for industrial use and make the government a first customer for startups.
